items.q: What should you remember about **Deliberate + mindset**?
items.a: **Ali Crum**: chosen stress ≠ imposed stress; placebo distinct from mindset effects.

items.q: What should you remember about **Uncomfortably cold rule**?
items.a: **want out but can stay** safely; harder at night than afternoon due to circadian temp.

items.q: What should you remember about **11 min/week floor**?
items.a: **consistency anchor for metabolism;** increase temp challenge when easy (colder, longer, or more frequent).

items.q: What should you remember about **Walls > time-only**?
items.a: **counting epinephrine surges scales** mental toughness without endlessly lowering temperature.

items.q: What should you remember about **Movement in cold**?
items.a: **breaks thermal layer; still** body = easier/cheating the stimulus.

items.q: What should you remember about **Dopamine without cortisol crash**?
items.a: **long elevated baseline mood/focus** vs drug-like peaks (Anna Lembke patient used cold for sobriety).

items.q: What should you remember about **Søberg principle**?
What should you remember about **Glabrous cooling ≠ ice packs on torso**?
items.a: **palms, soles, upper cheeks extract** core heat efficiently; armpit/groin packs less efficient and can trigger warming reflex.

items.q: What should you remember about **Palmar cooling = volume tool**?
items.a: **doubles/triples total work over** session, not necessarily first-set max.
**no direct groin-ice study; plausible** via dopamine→LH pathway; full immersion sufficient; groin-specific contact may risk tissue damage.
**early day cold amplifies** alertness; late evening may impair sleep via thermogenesis.
